title: Contract coverage discovered after repair

retrieve_on.symptom_narrative: We dispatch when the customer is under contract, but that does not mean the device or work is covered. A personal laptop was repaired at an office, and a part replacement was waived because nobody warned the customer about the charge. Lists are outdated.
retrieve_on.workflow_context: 18 staff; approximately 110 mixed PC, printer and network maintenance customers.

discriminating_questions.question: Is coverage organization-wide or asset-specific?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Both exist, depending on the agreement.
discriminating_questions.diagnostic_value: A customer match alone is insufficient.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: An unlisted device may be covered by a site-wide agreement; never classify it as excluded solely because the asset list is incomplete.

discriminating_questions.question: Who authorizes out-of-scope work?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Some site contacts may approve labor but not parts.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.question: Do technicians know a device is unlisted?
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.question: Can goodwill exceptions be made?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: The owner allows small exceptions but records no reason.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

positive_mechanism: Coverage decisions occur after irreversible work because scope and approval authority are not available at the point of service.
counterexample: An unlisted device may be covered by a site-wide agreement; never classify it as excluded solely because the asset list is incomplete.
minimum_evidence: A simulated device record identifies personal ownership.
A simulated contract excludes replacement parts.
A simulated work report contains no charge approval.
process_intervention: Define covered, excluded and uncertain states; provide a pre-work approval path and documented goodwill authority.
automation_candidate: Retrieve the effective agreement and asset scope; surface coverage evidence; create approval requests when scope changes.
unknowns: Spending limits and contract interpretation require owner confirmation.
stop_rule: If discriminating evidence is absent or conflicting, return an unresolved hypothesis plus a targeted question, not a confident solution.

capability_boundary.proposed_extension: Effective-dated coverage checks and approval controls are new capabilities.
capability_boundary.pricing: No price assigned; current rate card must not be extended by analogy.
